question.text: The form used by an SE to obtain a Unique Reference Number (URN) from the SSE for the impact assessment engagement is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Form RODD-A is the prescribed form for SE registration/URN disclosure on SSE. The other three are Companies Act forms unrelated to SSE listing. The Trap: PAS-3 (allotment), MGT-14 (resolutions) and AOC-4 (financial statement filing) are MCA-side filings — they do not cover URN issuance. Cross-Exam Context: Companies Act form confusion also appears in III-A / III-C (Compliance — filing calendar) and XIX-A/B/C/D/E (AIF — PPM-filing analogies). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep a one-page SSE-filing checklist alongside your engagement plan: URN via RODD-A, Annual Impact Report, disclosure of assessor details under SEBI LODR Ch IXA/IXB.
